lines.text: Namekian Heritage only. POWER: Shuffle the top
or bottom 3 cards of your discard pile into your
Life Deck.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 3 life cards, or 8 life
cards if Piccolo and Nail are in play. Banish after
use.
POWER: For the rest of Combat, Allies cannot
attack, stop attacks, or use their powers. Damage
cannot be redirected to Allies.
POWER: When entering Combat, banish all of your
opponent's Setups and Drills in play.
POWER: Raise any personality in play to its
highest stage. Its next energy attack this Combat
costs 0 stages.
POWER: For the rest of Combat, Krillin, Piccolo,
and Trunks cannot perform physical or energy
attacks, stop attacks against them, or use their
personality powers. Banish after use.
Attacks performed by your Allies deal +2
stages of damage.
Limit 1 per deck. POWER: Use at the end of a turn.
If your opponent's Main Personality is at level 4,
lower it 1 personality level.
When entering Combat as the defender, look
at the top 5 cards of your Life Deck and return
them to the top in any order.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards. HIT: Draw a card.
POWER: Raise your Main Personality to its highest
stage. Set all of your opponent's personalities to
4 stages above 0.
POWER: Raise your Main Personality to its highest
stage. Choose 3 cards from your discard pile and
place them on top of your Life Deck.
Cell only. POWER: Raise your Main Personality to
its highest stage. Lower all of your opponent's
Allies to 0 stages.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 5 life
cards. You may have 1 of your Allies lose 3 stages
to deal +5 stages of damage.
POWER: Banish a Battleground in play. You may
search your Life Deck for a Battleground and
place it in play to replace it.
Once per Combat, you may discard a card from
your hand to stop a physical or energy attack. If it
is Blue Style, lower your opponent's anger 2
levels.
Your opponents cannot perform energy
attacks.
POWER: Set all personalities with "Android" in
their title to 0 stages. They cannot gain stages
until the beginning of your next turn.
POWER: Once per Combat, instead of attacking,
you may discard a card from your hand. If it is
Black Style, your opponent discards a random
card; otherwise, they choose and discard a card.
When entering Combat, discard the top card
of your Life Deck. Draw 2 cards if it is Saiyan
Style; otherwise, draw 1 card.
When entering Combat, you may banish the
top card of your discard pile to make your
physical attacks deal +1 stage of damage this
Combat, or +3 stages if that card is Red Style.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. Place the
bottom 3 cards of your discard pile on the bottom
of your Life Deck.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +6 stages. Lower
your opponent's anger 3 levels. If "The Car" is in
play, this attack also deals 5 life cards of
damage.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. You may
use this power twice per Combat.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 5 stages and 3 life
cards.
Energy attack costing 0 stages. DAMAGE: 12
life cards.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 9 life
cards.
Energy attack costing 0 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards and 4 stages.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 5 life
cards. If you declared a Blue Toku-Waza, lower
your opponent's anger to 0. HIT: Raise Krillin to
his highest stage.
Your energy attacks deal +1 life card of
damage. Whenever your Orange Style energy
attack hits, your opponent cannot play a Physical
Combat card during their next attack phase.
When entering Combat, shuffle the top card of
your discard pile into your Life Deck. If it is
Namekian Style, draw a card.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. HIT: If
you declared a Toku-Waza, banish your
opponent's discard pile.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 1 life card. HIT: If the
top card of your opponent's discard pile is not a
physical attack, they discard the top 5 cards of
their Life Deck.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT stages. Your
opponent cannot take life cards or stages of
damage from this attack. You may use this Drill
twice per Combat.
Physical attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: AT
+2 stages. HIT: Your opponent discards X life
cards. X = 5 minus their anger level.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards. HIT: If you declared a Toku-Waza, banish
up to 2 of your opponent's Setups or Drills. Banish
after use.
Limit 1 per deck. Physical attacks against you
deal a maximum of 3 stages of damage.
POWER: Your Main Personality loses 4 stages.
Your attacks deal +3 life cards of damage for the
rest of Combat.
POWER: Raise your Main Personality to its highest
stage. Draw and reveal a card. If it is Namekian
Style, place 2 cards from your discard pile on the
bottom of your Life Deck. Banish after use.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +X stages. X = the
number of Allies you have in play.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +3 stages. If you
declared a Toku-Waza, for each life card of
damage dealt, place a card from your discard pile
on the bottom of your Life Deck. Banish after use.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: 7 stages. Discard the
top 2 cards of your Life Deck.
POWER: Put the bottom card of your discard pile
into your hand. If it is Namekian Style, you may
search your Life Deck for an Energy Combat card
and put it into your hand. Banish after use.
Defense Shield: When defending in Combat,
stop the first unstopped attack against you. When
entering Combat, draw a card.
Energy attack costing 2 stages. DAMAGE: 4 life
cards. HIT: Each Ally your opponent has in play
loses 4 stages.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +2 stages. Lower
your opponent's anger to 0. They cannot gain
anger until the beginning of their next turn.
POWER: Search your Life Deck for up to 7 Allies
and place them in play at 3 stages above 0.
Banish after use.
Limit 2 per deck. POWER: Banish all Allies in play.
Banish after use.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +9 stages.
Physical attack. DAMAGE: AT +5 stages and 5
life cards.
